title: code-divider configuration
description: Settings for code-divider (code-divider.config.json). Every setting is optional and overrides the built-in default. Any key other than "filter" and "All" is a language block; set a built-in language to null to remove it.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor support.

filter.description: Which files to process, relative to the folder being processed. Patterns work like include/exclude in a tsconfig.json.

include.description: Process only matching files. An empty list means a full recursive search.

exclude.description: Skip matching files and folders. Replaces the built-in exclusions; use [] to exclude nothing.

All.description: Settings shared by every language. A language block may override any of them.

^\\$.description: Keys starting with "$" are ignored by code-divider.

CharacterLimit.description: The column that generated header lines extend to, indentation included. Default: 79.

FillerCharacter.description: The single character used to fill the header lines. Default: "=".

RegionLabelFormat.description: How region (@reg) labels are capitalized. Default: "uppercase".

SectionLabelFormat.description: How section (@sec) labels are capitalized. Default: "capitalize".

language.description: A language: the files it matches, the comment syntax markers are written in, and any overrides of the shared settings. A new language needs at least Extensions and Comment.

Extensions.description: File extensions to match, e.g. ["py"]. Case-insensitive; the leading dot is optional.

Comment.description: The [start, end] comment syntax markers are written in. Use "" as the end for line comments, e.g. ["# ", ""].

Bookends.description: The [start, end] strings of each generated header line. Defaults to Comment; for line comments the opener is mirrored on the right, e.g. ["# ", " #"].
